items.question: Which additional subjects concerning tradition, royal histories, and ancient narratives are requested for instruction?
premises: The speaker continues a request to hear about specific subjects.
Tradition and the course of kings are named as topics.
The ancient narratives are included as an additional subject.
items.inference: The requested instruction extends to tradition, the histories of kings, and the Purāṇas.
uncertainties: The identity of the addressee Viśa is not specified in this verse.
The exact sense of gatiḥ as course, conduct, or destiny depends on context.
items.plain_english: O Viśa, I wish to hear about tradition, the course of kings, and the Purāṇas as well.
